description: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores for several large language models (LLMs) across six different evaluation tasks: TTS, Llama-2-3B-Instruct, Llama-3-1-405B-Instruct, ol-mini, DeepSeek-R1, and ol-preview, on the MATH-500 and AIME24 datasets. The horizontal axis represents the model and dataset combination, with categories labeled “3B”, “unk”, “405B”, “1.5B”, “671B”, and “7B” for each model and dataset, and the vertical axis represents the performance score, labeled “CoT” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each model’s performance is represented by a stacked bar, with each color representing a specific evaluation task. For example, TTS is represented by a purple bar, Llama-2-3B-Instruct by a blue bar, Llama-3-1-405B-Instruct by a red bar, ol-mini by an orange bar, DeepSeek-R1 by a gray bar, and ol-preview by a brown bar. The shortest bar is for TTS on the 7B/unk dataset, with a value of approximately 70, while the tallest bar is for TTS on the 3B/(a) dataset, with a value of 95. The bars are sorted alphabetically by model name, and the Llama-3-1-405B-Instruct and ol-preview bars are visually emphasized with a spiral symbol.
